sentences.text: Piratosaurus belongs to the group Plesiosauria, a diverse clade of marine reptiles.
The entire known fossil record consists of just one single tooth designated as the holotype.
Joseph Leidy named and described this genus in 1865 from Late Cretaceous-aged rocks in the Red River basin of Manitoba.
Some researchers have incorrectly assumed the fossils were found in Minnesota.
Piratosaurus is considered a dubious genus of plesiosaur that may belong to the family Polycotylidae.
Fossils of Piratosaurus date to the Late Cretaceous period.
